_why: What each screen still clips when the type dial is at its top and the root is scaled with it. Recorded by scripts/screenshots/typescale.mjs so the number can FALL and never RISE. IT IS ZERO EVERYWHERE, and staying there is the point: every entry used to be the same defect — a work title or a person's name wearing Tailwind's `truncate` — and the rule says a name is never truncated, so they were converted to NameScroll (ui.jsx) and the file is now a floor rather than a debt. A screen that goes above zero has introduced a new one; the answer is to fix it, not to write the number here.
_recorded: 2026-09-01. Was 47 across three screens when first taken (2026-08-30), rose to 98 when the rail took 236px off every screen, and fell to 0 when the 36 name-bearing truncates became NameScroll, the rail learned to drop its words instead of growing, and the timeline's tick row stopped being a px box.
_notCovered: WHAT THIS RATCHET CANNOT SEE, said here because a floor of zero reads as 'nothing in this app truncates' and that is not what it measures. typescale.mjs visits ROUTES: it goes to each screen at rest and looks at what is on it. Nothing behind a press — a panel, a sub-sheet, a menu, a dialog — is ever opened, so a clip there is outside this file's reach in both directions. There are exactly FOUR deliberate clips in the app, all on a header and all the owner's ruling: the back crumb (.tp-panel-back-word), granted 2026-09-06; the panel TITLE (.tp-panel-title), granted 2026-09-07 — "the title doesn't need to scroll in the header. it can be ellipsis-ed. not a problem."; and the add surface's header PAIR (.mobile-sheet-title on a phone, .add-head-title on a desk, with .add-head-sub under each), granted 2026-09-11 — "the header names can get ellipsis. they do not need to have edgemask sidescroll or infinite wrap. one line is enough", paid for by the same instruction's second half, "for second line get the author/director whatever in smaller font", which is what turned one name that would not fit into a name and its author. Each is argued at its declaration in index.css. All live on a header a press opens, so this ratchet has never counted any of them. They are checked by no-truncated-names.test.js (which holds both exceptions with their rulings), crumb-stays-in-its-slot.test.js (the declarations) and run-panel-depth.sh (the rectangles, in a browser at 390).
